solutions.title: Locate the two middle entries
solutions.explanation:
We only need the two middle entries of the sorted list, so counting entries below a useful cutoff avoids sorting all \(4040\) numbers.

For an even number of entries, the median is the average of the two middle values. Here those occupy positions \(2020\) and \(2021\).

Since
\[
44^2=1936\qquad\text{and}\qquad45^2=2025,
\]
there are exactly \(44\) entries from the square list at or below \(1936\). Together with the integers \(1\) through \(1936\), this gives
\[
1936+44=1980
\]
entries at or below \(1936\). Repeated numerical values count separately because they are separate entries in the list.

The next entries are \(1937,1938,\ldots,2020\), each appearing once, because the next square is \(2025\). Therefore position \(2020\), which is \(40\) positions after position \(1980\), contains
\[
1936+40=1976.
\]
The following position contains \(1977\). Hence the median is
\[
\boxed{\frac{1976+1977}{2}=1976.5},
\]
which is choice \(\textbf{C}\).

solutions.title: Trim both ends equally
solutions.explanation:
Removing equally many entries from the two ends of a sorted list preserves its middle pair, and therefore its median. Here this leaves a short list of consecutive integers.

Because
\[
44^2=1936\qquad\text{and}\qquad45^2=2025,
\]
the entries at most \(1936\) consist of the \(1936\) integers from the first list and \(44\) entries from the square list. Counting repeated values separately, remove these \(1980\) smallest entries.

To remove \(1980\) entries from the upper end, first remove all squares from \(45^2\) through \(2020^2\). They exceed \(2020\), and their number is
\[
2020-45+1=1976.
\]
The next four largest entries are \(2020,2019,2018,2017\). Removing these completes the upper-end removal.

The remaining \(4040-2(1980)=80\) entries are exactly
\[
1937,1938,\ldots,2016.
\]
Pairs taken equally far from the ends all have sum \(1937+2016\), including the middle pair. Thus the median of both the remaining list and the original list is
\[
\boxed{\frac{1937+2016}{2}=1976.5},
\]
which is choice \(\textbf{C}\).
